description: This Java class defines a global exception handler in a Spring Boot application, designed to uniformly handle validation errors caused by invalid request data, providing structured error responses with HTTP 400 status.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring component annotated with @ControllerAdvice for handling exceptions globally across controllers, specifically catching validation errors and returning custom error responses.

methods.name: handleValidationExceptions
methods.description: Handles MethodArgumentNotValidException thrown during validation failures. It constructs a response body with error details, including individual field errors, and returns a ResponseEntity with HTTP 400 status.
